description.value: Your study of kyber crystals has stirred a latent Force sensitivity. At 6th level, choose two 1st-level force powers; you treat them as tech powers, and they don't count against the number of powers listed in your Powers Known column. At 7th level you learn two more force powers of 1st or 2nd level, at 13th level two more of 1st through 3rd level, and at 17th level two more of 1st through 4th level. Whenever you gain a level in this class, you may swap one force power you know for another of the same level.
